selection_note: Bovine AQP1 biological assembly 1: author-assigned C4 homotetramer. Select all resolved polymer heavy atoms in the four generated chains; do not use the asymmetric unit or assembly 2 octamer.

orientation.note: Local +Z points extracellularly. For each of four chains, average the first/last four resolved CA atoms of six UniProt P47865 full transmembrane spans, alternating N-side cytoplasmic/extracellular. Average 24 exterior and 24 interior helix ends; their midpoint is the origin and their difference defines Z. Project source X perpendicular to Z and set Y=cross(Z,X). All 249 modeled author-numbered residues match the UniProt sequence. This is an inferred membrane frame, not OPM or an experimentally measured embedding.

limitations: Bovine AQP1 X-ray model at 2.2 Angstrom. Each selected chain has 249 modeled residues of a 271-residue sequence; missing terminal residues are not reconstructed.
The polymer-only envelope omits waters and BNG detergent molecules; no glycans are reconstructed.
Gaussian envelopes can occlude a narrow channel. This is a static membrane asset, not a qualified pore surface, water trajectory, proton-exclusion demonstration or gating model.
